root_cause: The exclusive checkbox uses an empty string value for the data-checkbox-exclusive attribute (data-checkbox-exclusive=""), which the NHSUK checkboxes module may not recognize as a boolean flag, preventing the mutual-exclusion behavior that clears other checkboxes in the group when the exclusive option is selected.
repair_strategy: Change the attribute to a boolean presence (no value) to match the expected markup, allowing the module to detect the exclusive flag and clear other checkboxes in the group.

edits.before: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive="" data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">
edits.after: <input class="nhsuk-checkboxes__input" id="symptoms-none" name="symptoms[none]" type="checkbox" value="yes" data-checkbox-exclusive data-checkbox-exclusive-group="symptoms">

expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard users will now be able to select the “No, I do not have any of these symptoms” option and have any previously selected symptom checkboxes automatically cleared, meeting the exclusive choice behavior and preserving form data integrity.
functional_risks: If any custom script depends on the attribute having an empty string value, it may need updating.
Ensure the change does not affect visual styling or form validation.
verification_requirements: Verify that selecting the exclusive option via mouse or keyboard clears any previously selected symptom checkboxes.
Verify that selecting a symptom after the exclusive option clears the exclusive option (if that behavior is also required).
Confirm that form submission reflects the correct values for symptoms[none] and symptom checkboxes.
Ensure the contact checkboxes exclusive behavior remains unchanged.
